absolute_tolerances.basis: The ARIES manifest class for the same closure body (native root termination 1e-8 MW plus roundoff); declared before execution, comparison-contract.md section 9.
Two ULP of the capital magnitude for the subtractive IDC diagnostic; the ARIES class for the same lifecycle body; declared before execution.
The ARIES exact-zero difference class (economics goal L-004); declared before execution.

Two temperatures of order 700 K fixed by the closure's root solve (native termination 1e-8 MW on the duty; the oracle's Brent root differs by about 3e-10 K) are subtracted to a margin that can be arbitrarily small near the bound, so a relative rule cannot pass it; 1e-6 K is a verification tolerance on a calculated temperature margin only, never permission to accept a physical constraint violation (the verdict is re-derived exactly from the operands). Declared after execution of study 20260926-design-study-parameters on the owner's ruling G-001 of 2026-09-26 (work/orchestration/goals/design-study-parameters/evidence/owner-ruling-g001.md), the one refusal being 5.3e-10 K absolute on a 0.363 K margin.
